name: CourseIntelligence
tagline: Turns student Reddit discussions and course catalogs into comparable course profiles: difficulty, workload, professors.
problem: Choosing courses means digging through scattered student opinions.
solution: Scrapes university subreddits, joins them with catalog data, and uses AI in a data platform to standardize opinions into metrics per course.
demo_moment: Team-described: look up a course and see its difficulty and workload from student posts.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Databricks: Best Use of Databricks” among 261 submissions.
Processed a large scraped corpus inside the sponsor's platform.

lessons: Data-platform prizes reward a real pipeline over a pretty front end.
